resources.string: On Auralys PC, open Settings > Backup > Sync with phone. A QR code appears.
Make sure the phone and the PC are on the same Wi-Fi, then tap Scan QR.
Playlists, liked songs, saved albums and artists, play history and searches are merged on both sides. Nothing is deleted, and your YouTube Music login is not sent.
Point the camera at the QR code on the PC screen
Camera permission denied. Allow it in the phone settings or use Paste code.
Waiting for confirmation on the PC. Choose Merge in the PC window.
No new data, both sides are already the same.
%1$d new saved albums, artists and playlists
%1$d songs added to the database (not shown in Library)
%1$d entries skipped because the song info is missing
A safety backup was created before merging (%1$s) and is stored in the private app folder. Save a copy to be able to restore the data through Backup and restore.
Save a copy of the backup
Backup copy could not be saved
The merge was cancelled on the PC. Nothing changed on the phone.
This is not an Auralys PC sync code. Scan the QR shown in the sync window on the PC.

Could not connect to the PC. Check: 1) the phone and the PC are on the same Wi-Fi (not a guest network or mobile data), 2) the sync window on the PC is still open, 3) Windows Firewall allows Auralys (choose Allow if asked), 4) the VPN on the phone is off.
The PC closed the connection. The QR may have expired (valid for 3 minutes) or the sync window was closed. Open a new QR on the PC, then scan again.
The PC did not respond in time. Make sure the sync window is still open, then try again.
The sync versions on the PC and the phone differ. Update Auralys on both.
The PC sent an unexpected reply. Make sure both apps are up to date, then try again.
An error occurred on the phone while reading or merging data. The merge is applied in one step, so a failed step changes nothing. Detail: %1$s
Connection lost. Check the Wi-Fi, then try again.
